name: Philips Hue White Ambiance GU10 (350 lm, EU)

radios.note: Hue lists Bluetooth and Zigbee for this EAN.

matter.note: The product pages we saw don't mention Matter for this EAN and we found no CSA listing for it. Hue's guide offers Matter through the Hue Bridge. Not confirmed for the bulb itself.

apple_home.note: Hue's pages list Apple Home (HomeKit) as working via the Hue Bridge.

google_home.note: Through Hue's own Google integration. The product page lists Google Assistant under 'Hue Bridge required'; Hue's (US) FAQ says Bluetooth bulbs work bridgeless with Google Nest speakers and displays.

alexa.note: Through Hue's own Alexa integration. The product page lists Alexa under 'Hue Bridge required'; Hue's (US) FAQ says Bluetooth bulbs can pair with most Echo devices without a Bridge.

smartthings.note: The pages we saw for this EAN don't mention SmartThings. Other Hue bulbs list it under 'Hue Bridge required', but we couldn't confirm it for this one.

home_assistant.note: Official Hue integration (via Hue Bridge) and official Hue BLE integration (since 2025.12, bridgeless Bluetooth). The BLE docs don't name this specific bulb.

hubRequired.note: Here this means needing a bridge for basic app control. The Hue app controls it over Bluetooth; voice assistants, Apple Home and the full feature set need a Hue Bridge.

localControl.note: Bluetooth control from a phone works without internet; Home Assistant talks to the Hue Bridge over its local API.

colorType.note: Adjustable white from 2200 to 6500 K; no colour.

lumens.note: 350 lm at 4000 K for EAN 8719514339903. A newer White Ambiance GU10 (EAN 8720169229976) is rated at 400 lm; check the EAN on the box.

summary: The EU Philips Hue White Ambiance GU10 (EAN 8719514339903) is a tunable white spotlight, 2200 to 6500 K, rated at 350 lumens. It has Bluetooth and Zigbee: the Hue app controls it directly over Bluetooth, while voice assistants and Apple Home need a Hue Bridge. Home Assistant supports it through the official Hue and Hue BLE integrations.
caveats: Apple Home and voice assistants need a Hue Bridge, according to Hue's product page for this EAN.
Hue's German shop lists this EAN as no longer available; its successor (EAN 8720169229976) is rated at 400 lm.
Bluetooth mode is limited to a few lights in short range and has no remote access.
